breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.001 with 600 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.5.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that 600 time steps with dt=0.001 would result in a final time of T=0.6, which contradicts the specified domain T=0.5. The agent corrected the number of time steps to 500 (since 0.5 / 0.001 = 500), which matches the ground truth.
